how to make modern contraceptive methods available and acceptable to women who wish to delay the first pregnancy.
how to ensure that young women have access to the full range of contraceptive options and that they are able to exercise informed choices about which method is right for them.
the issue of age and method restrictions for young people who wish to delay first birth and how they affect their access to and use of modern contraceptions.

the use of contraceptives to postpone the first birth in Tanzania is acceptable but there are some challenges that need to be addressed to ensure the provision of services to those who wish to delay.
